name: cli-session-buffer
body: The pending change set of a live session: the cumulative in-memory node-file writes and deletes accepted since the previous save. A node's current content is the buffer's pending entry for a node the session changed earlier in the run, and the live database's entry for a node the session has not changed; the live database is held open by the session for its whole life. The buffer and the live database together hold every field a node file carries. A save makes the buffer durable and empties it; an abort discards it. A mutation is built against the cumulative buffer, so a later change composes over every earlier pending change. Removing a node that was durable — backed by a node file saved before it first entered the buffer — removes its node file at save, even when the same unsaved run updated it or changed its edges first; a node added and then removed within one unsaved run leaves no node file and no delete.
